source.name: Circular-explanation development
source.notes: Synthetic passages authored for the accepted definition and reviewed blind through authenticated Claude Opus. Other checks remain unassessed.

snippets: I explained my sense of being out of place by the absence of a feeling that I belonged among the guests.
The researchers ascribe the result's robustness to its resistance to losing validity under altered conditions.
We know the plan is feasible because carrying it out is possible; that possibility is why we consider it feasible.
The hospitality of the household was explained by its welcoming disposition toward guests.
The reason Anton is indispensable is that we cannot do without him.
The investigator's answer was its believability: one could accept it as true, which accounted for its credibility.
What makes the oath binding? Its obligatory character. And what gives it that character? The fact that it binds those who take it.
Our supplier review labels the quotation unreasonable. The justification is that the terms exceed what could reasonably be accepted.
The buyer replied that it was not fitted to the intended use. Suitability itself was his only explanation.
The accountant replied that it represented an unproductive use of money. That unproductiveness was her explanation for calling it wasteful.
We called the arrangement equitable on the basis that it treated the parties fairly. Asked why the treatment was fair, we pointed to the equity of the arrangement.
Our annual review explains the partnership's durability by saying that the relationship has the capacity to endure.
the review points to that enduring quality as the reason the partnership is durable
The village chronicle explains the innkeeper's generosity through his habit of being liberal in what he gave to others.
Asked to explain the venture's success, the founder said it had managed to succeed.
The spokesman located the cause of public confusion in people's inability to make sense of the situation.
The school credits its inclusiveness to being a place where people are included.
The narrator ascribes the sisters' estrangement to their state of alienation from one another.
The essay locates the origin of the judge's impartiality in her freedom from bias. It attributes that freedom, in turn, to her impartial nature.
Elise remained loyal thanks to her steadfast allegiance. That allegiance, the narrator explains, arose from her loyalty.
The firm can depend on the estimate because the estimate is dependable.
Why did I regard the choice as trivial? It was of little consequence, which is what made it trivial.
Why is the route accessible? The reason is that people can get to it. That ability to reach it explains its accessibility.
The senator's influence was attributed to her ability to affect what other people did. That capacity, the biography says, explains her influence.
His answer deserved skepticism because it was not something one could confidently believe.
The diagnosis of inflexibility rests on the team's inability to adapt. When asked what prevents adaptation, the report cites its lack of flexibility.
The witness was evasive, a quality the report attributes to his unwillingness to give a direct answer.
I asked my brother why he had become so reluctant to discuss the house.
gave his reason: talking about the property was something he now felt unwilling to do.
The kingdom was unstable because its affairs lacked stability.
The narrator explains the merchant's greed by his inordinate desire to acquire more.
What produced the design's elegance was its graceful refinement.
How did the guarantee acquire its authority? From its standing as an authoritative guarantee, according to the agent.
The delay was intolerable for the reason that it could no longer be endured.
For Mara, the journey felt endless owing to the sensation that it would never end.
The poem is profound on account of the depth of its meaning. That depth, the review continues, comes from its profundity.
The officer explained that the permit was invalid because it had no validity.
The captain's explanation for the crew's obedience was their willingness to do as they were told.
When counsel asked what made them willing, he cited their readiness to comply as the underlying cause.
What accounted for its power to convince? Its ability to make a compelling case.
How does the design ensure simplicity? By keeping the design simple.
The council identifies a lack of unanimity as the cause of its members not all agreeing.
In explanation, it stated that he had failed to exercise due care, and attributed that failure to his negligence.
The handbook accounts for the procedure's complexity by saying that it is complicated.
The publisher credited the manuscript's compactness. When I asked what had produced that compactness, he pointed to how short the manuscript was.
the prospect of attending held no appeal for her; that was why she did not want to go
The biography explains his courage by his capacity to be brave.
This indecision came from being unable to make up my mind.
What accounts for the observation's accuracy? Its correspondence with what is really the case. That correspondence is the reason it is accurate.
We describe the service as affordable because paying for it is within people's means. This affordability explains why it is affordable.
It had failed to give me a feeling of satisfaction, I decided, and that failure explained my discontent.
The notes explain the speaker's confidence by saying she felt sure of herself.
the report says the dispatch was late owing to its failure to leave on time
The gardener said the path's crookedness resulted from its failure to follow a straight course.
The lecture is compulsory because attendance is obligatory. Why is attendance obligatory? Because the lecture is compulsory.
The station review attributes the platform's unsafe condition to a lack of safety on the platform.
Her refusal was final for a simple reason: it would admit no further reconsideration.
Her answer traced that coherence to the fact that the pieces formed a unified whole.
The reason for the festival's popularity is that a great many people like it.
The committee explained the ruling's consistency by the absence of inconsistency in its rulings.
The plan was called prudent because it displayed sound caution. Its cautious nature was then explained by the prudence of the plan.
The townspeople's resentment was explained by their bitter feelings about the matter. Those feelings, the chronicle says, arose from resentment.
The narrator credits the child's curiosity to an eagerness to learn about unfamiliar things. That eagerness is explained as a consequence of being curious.
The panel found the amendment superfluous because it added nothing that was needed. Asked why nothing was needed, it cited the amendment's superfluity.
Their predicament was difficult to resolve. The adviser put this down to the absence of an easy solution to their predicament.
What explains the scarcity of appointments? There are very few appointments available. That scarcity is the explanation.
The association's minutes give one reason for calling the proposal legitimate: it has a rightful claim to acceptance.
When a member asked what established that rightful claim, the answer was the proposal's legitimacy.
How did the club achieve exclusivity? By being an organization whose membership was exclusive.
The proposal's urgency stems from the necessity of addressing it without delay.
The dish delighted him. The reason for that pleasure was how delightful he found the dish.
What made the decision arbitrary? It rested on no consistent principle. Asked why it lacked such a principle, the officer pointed to its arbitrariness.
His aunt replied that he possessed sound judgment, and she attributed that judgment to his wisdom.
Asked why Lena was the strongest candidate, the chair explained that she surpassed everyone else in suitability for the position.
The department replied that dispensing with the restriction was not an available option.
Asked for the reason it could not be dispensed with, the department said it was necessary.
My unease about the arrangement came from how uncomfortable I felt about it.
The room was inhospitable on account of its unwelcoming character. That character accounted for its lack of hospitality, the guest wrote.
The alliance remained secret thanks to the fact that nobody outside it knew about it.
The witness said she forgot because the information had slipped her mind.
The evaluation calls the search results relevant. To explain that assessment, it says the results pertain to what the user is looking for.
the director accounts for the ending's inevitability by saying that no other outcome could have occurred
The novelist explains the letter's ambiguity through its capacity to admit more than one interpretation. That capacity is attributed to the letter being ambiguous.
The bank attributes the account's security to the fact that the account is secure.
Why does the solution work? It is an effective solution, the adviser explained. Its effectiveness is the source of its ability to work.
A consultant described the revised process as efficient on the grounds that it used resources efficiently.
she repeated that efficient resource use accounted for the process's efficiency
The report says residents trust the cooperative because they have confidence in it.
When the funding officer asked what produced that confidence, the response referred her back to the sentence explaining residents' trust.
The reviewer accounted for the narrative's vagueness by observing that its meaning was insufficiently precise.
The travel agent put the timetable's unreliability down to its failure to be dependable.
The council called the application inadmissible. The reason given was that it could not be admitted for consideration.
I was unconvinced because the argument had left me without conviction.
The commission regards the outcome as inevitable. Its explanation is the impossibility of any different result.
The dealer answered that its originality arose from being unlike any other work.
The exchange was reciprocal, the report explains, on account of its mutual nature.
The audit gives noncompliance with the rules as the reason the department failed to comply with the rules.
The proof was unsound because it could not serve as a sound proof.
The brochure explains the site's remoteness in terms of its being far from other places.
The board's answer to why the policy is appropriate is that it suits the situation in which it will be used.
The study concludes that the outcome was unpredictable since it could not be foreseen.
Darius's composure came from his unruffled state of mind; his mental calm was the source of his composure.
Why was the performance memorable? It left an impression that stayed in the memory.
The speech lacked substance, which the reviewer explained by its failure to say anything substantive.
Their disagreement lasted because their views continued to diverge.
The guide attributes the poem's obscurity to the difficulty of understanding what it means.
The explanation for my sense of isolation was my feeling of being cut off from everyone.
